name: REPLACE-ME-with-your-domain-name
description: TEMPLATE — copy this file, rename it (e.g. my-domain.json), and fill `questions` with YOUR real domain Q&A. This is the ONLY input that produces answer-quality numbers reflecting YOUR production system; the bundled generic set is a wiring smoke, not a measure of your domain. Run it with:  go run ./bench/answer-quality -data ./my-domain.json -n 50 . Each question needs `question`; `ideal_answer` and `context_docs` are optional but strongly recommended — `ideal_answer` lets the correctness judge compare against a gold target, and `context_docs` are seeded into the memory tier so the turn's real retrieval can ground the answer AND the faithfulness/hallucination axes can be scored.

questions.question: Ask a real question your users actually ask.
questions.ideal_answer: The gold/ideal answer you would accept as correct (substance, not exact wording). Omit if you have no reference answer.

context_docs.text: Paste the actual knowledge-base text/passage the answer should be grounded in. The harness seeds this into the memory tier so retrieval can surface it, and the faithfulness judge checks the answer against it.
You can attach multiple documents. Only documents relevant to a given question need to be attached to that question.

questions.question: A question where you have a gold answer but no single source document.
questions.ideal_answer: The answer you expect. Correctness and helpfulness are scored; faithfulness is skipped (no context to check against).

questions.question: A question with no reference answer and no context. Correctness is judged against the query alone; helpfulness is still scored; faithfulness is skipped.
